text: dsh-ui-scale 是 DSH 网页与桌面客户端的界面缩放插件。它在设置的“常规”区域加入缩放控制，并在页面首次绘制前注入缩放适配逻辑。用户可用滑块、百分比输入框或预设值，将界面调至 50%–200%；实现会换算页面尺寸、元素位置、指针与部分媒体查询，并保存缩放配置。桌面端还会记住非全屏窗口的尺寸和位置。适合需要放大或缩小 DSH 工作界面的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-ui-scale scales the DSH web and desktop interface from 50% to 200%. General settings provide a slider, percentage field, and presets. It adjusts page measurements, saves the chosen scale, and restores desktop window size and position. No API key or external service is needed.

dsh-ui-scale 的功能「界面缩放控制」：在 Settings > General 中通过滑块（5% 步进）、百分比输入或 100、110、125、150、175、200% 预设调整页面缩放，范围为 50%–200%。
dsh-ui-scale 的功能「页面尺寸适配」：启用后应用 CSS zoom，并换算元素矩形、视口尺寸、滚动与指针坐标等页面测量值，使页面布局按缩放后的 CSS 像素工作。
dsh-ui-scale 的功能「保存缩放设置」：用户更改缩放时通过配置表单写入 scale 配置，并订阅已保存值以同步界面；默认值为 100%，有效范围为 50%–200%。
dsh-ui-scale 的功能「恢复桌面窗口尺寸」：桌面端定期保存非全屏窗口的尺寸和位置，并在启动时恢复；超出屏幕的尺寸会收缩，无法显示的异屏位置不会恢复。
dsh-ui-scale 使用前须知：部分样式表注入方式、Shadow DOM、MathML 以及 IntersectionObserver 与触摸坐标未纳入完整缩放换算，相关内容可能仍按原始视口尺寸呈现。

dsh-ui-scale README · dsh-ui-scale：Make the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) interface larger or smaller, from 50% to 200%. Works in the browser (`dsh web`) and in the Desktop app.

dsh-ui-scale README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-scale
```

In the Desktop app, open Plugins, choose Add plugin, enter `dsh-ui-scale` and install it.

dsh-ui-scale README · Use：Open Settings > General > Interface scale. There are three ways to set the scale:

- Drag the slider. It moves in 5% steps and applies the scale when you release it.
- Type a percent in the field and press Enter or click elsewhere. The value is rounded to a whole percent, and a value below 50 or above 200 is set to the nearest limit.
- Click a preset: 100, 110, 125, 150, 175 or 200%.

dsh-ui-scale README · Use：The scale is saved in the profile configuration. It survives restarts and is applied before the main window appears. Each profile (`web`, `desktop`) keeps its own value, and every browser signed in to the same profile shares it. In dsh 0.2.0 a page opened from another computer can change the scale only for itself until it reloads, because that version does not save settings from such pages.

dsh-ui-scale README · What scales：Everything in the window: sidebars, conversation, composer, pages, Settings and other dialogs, and the menus, tooltips and pop-ups attached to them. The layout behaves as it would under browser zoom: at a high scale in a small window the left sidebar collapses, panels keep their share of the window, and dragging a divider follows the pointer.

The Desktop app's native menus and window controls keep their normal size.

dsh-ui-scale README · Desktop window size：The Desktop app opens its window at the same default size on every start. With this plugin enabled it opens at the size and position you left it in. The window is not resized past the screen, and a position on another display is not restored, so the window opens on the main display at the saved size. Full screen is not saved.

dsh-ui-scale README · Limits：The plugin applies CSS zoom and converts what the page measures to the zoomed scale: element positions and sizes, the window and page viewport size, pointer positions, SVG screen matrices, wheel deltas, media queries (widths and resolutions) in style sheets and `matchMedia`, and the viewport units in style sheets and inline styles. Some things fall outside that conversion:

dsh-ui-scale README · Limits：- A viewport size (`vw`, `vh`) in a style rule added from script with `insertRule`, in a constructed style sheet added with `adoptedStyleSheets.push` instead of assignment, inside a shadow root, or on a MathML element is not converted. Such an element can come out larger than the window.
- `IntersectionObserver` rectangles and touch coordinates still use the real window size.
- A size measured in the same script step that sets an inline viewport size or adds a style element still sees the unconverted value; the next step sees the converted one.
- Every script on the page sees the converted values, including other plugins. The one exception is the Desktop account Usage and Top up area, whose position and size read in window pixels so the app can place those pages.
- A PDF that is already open keeps its sharpness from before a scale change until it is reloaded, opened again or zoomed in the preview.
dsh-ui-scale README · Limits：In a browser you can also use the browser's own zoom; the two multiply.

dsh-ui-scale README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` | `100` | Interface scale in percent, a whole number from 50 to 200. |

The settings row writes this field. You can also set it in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: ui-scale
  name: dsh-ui-scale
  config:
    scale: 125

dsh-ui-scale README · Development：Use Node.js 24. Install dependencies with `npm ci`. Run `npm run check` for formatting, lint, JavaScript syntax and strict TypeScript checks. Run `npm test` to build and test the shipped bundle.

dsh-ui-scale README · Development：Type suppressions must use `@ts-expect-error: <reason>`. Inline lint suppressions must name one rule: `biome-ignore lint/<group>/<rule>: <reason>`. Blanket and file-wide lint suppressions are rejected. Non-null assertions remain allowed where TypeScript cannot follow an existing guard. The npm-generated lockfile is not reformatted.

dsh-ui-scale README · Development：Pull requests and pushes to `main` run the same check and test commands. The `CI passed` summary succeeds only when both jobs succeed; failed, cancelled and skipped jobs fail the summary.

Tested with dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 (web in Chrome and the macOS Desktop app) and dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (web in Chrome).
